席墨没想到会有这么一出，看到网上那些照片，好半天都没回过神。

他一直都知道夏萱并不是像外界表现的那般，但是他以为顶多是和那些千金小姐一样，高傲目中无人了一点，他绝对没有想过她曾经有可能杀过人。

“席总，席董事长电话。”助理拿着手机进来，说话都不敢大喘气。

现在的BOSS比之前还可怕。

席墨‘啪’的一下合上电脑，接过助理手中的电话。

“爸。”

“召开发布会，和夏萱解除婚约。”电话那端的男人语气很强硬，“我不管你想做什么，现在夏萱都不能在是你的未婚妻，记住了吗？”

“我知道了。”

席墨挂了电话，神色微沉，“去安排发布会。”

#东方娱乐总裁单方面宣布与影后夏萱解除婚约，是否代表夏萱曾经真的杀过人？#

新闻一出，夏萱的电话就打到了席墨手机上。

席墨看都没看，直接将手机关机。

夏萱这个女人，只能放弃了，东方娱乐正是关键时期，不能因为夏萱，毁了他的计划。

夏萱不敢出门，外面全是蹲点的记者，甚至是有愤怒的网友，如果不是她住的小区安保设施不错，恐怕那些人都要冲进她家门了。

但是小区又不是只有夏萱一个人，甚至是还有别的明星，那么的多记者和人，他们出行都受到了严重的阻碍。

警察最终不得不介入调查。

“叮咚！”

“叮咚叮咚！！”

门铃急促的响着，外面穿着警服的人对视了几眼，让人去叫物业的来开门。

门一打开，一股血腥味就扑面而来。客厅的沙发上，夏萱只穿着吊带睡裙，一只手垂在空中，手腕上一条长长的伤口，鲜血滴答滴答的顺着指尖滴落在铺着羊毛的地毯上，将白色的地毯染成了红色。

“警官，请问夏萱是畏罪自杀吗？”医护人员一出来，记者就围了上去。

“夏萱是他杀还是自杀？她真的是211分尸案的凶手吗？警官，请你说几句。”

“抱歉，不方便透露，请让一让。”警察将记者分开，护送着夏萱上了救护车。

#夏萱畏罪自杀#

#211分尸案凶手#

热搜上都被211分尸案承包了。

Xi Mo didn't expect something like this to happen. After seeing those photos on the Internet, he couldn't recover for a long time.

He had always known that Xia Xuan was not as she appeared to the outside world, but he thought that at most she was just like those wealthy ladies, arrogant and arrogant. He never thought that she might have killed someone before.

"Mr. Xi, Chairman Xi's phone number." The assistant came in with a mobile phone, not daring to breathe loudly while speaking.

The current BOSS is even scarier than before.

Xi Mo closed the computer with a snap and took the phone from his assistant.

"Dad."

"Convene a press conference to terminate the engagement with Xia Xuan." The man on the other end of the phone said in a strong tone, "I don't care what you want to do, Xia Xuan can no longer be your fiancee, remember?"

"I understand."

Xi Mo hung up the phone and said with a gloomy expression, "Go and arrange the press conference."

#Oriental Entertainment CEO unilaterally announced the termination of her engagement with actress Xia Xuan. Does this mean that Xia Xuan has actually killed someone?#

As soon as the news came out, Xia Xuan's call came to Xi Mo's mobile phone.

Xi Mo turned off his phone without even looking at it.

Xia Xuan, this woman, had no choice but to give up. Oriental Entertainment was at a critical period, and his plans could not be ruined because of Xia Xuan.

Xia Xuan did not dare to go out. There were reporters outside, and even some angry netizens. If the security facilities in the community where she lived were not good, those people might have rushed into her door.

But Xia Xuan is not the only one in the community, there are even other celebrities, there are so many reporters and people, their travel is severely hindered.

The police eventually had to step in to investigate.

"Ding dong!"

“Ding dong ding dong!!”

The doorbell rang rapidly, and the people in police uniforms outside looked at each other a few times and asked someone to call the property manager to open the door.

As soon as the door opened, the smell of blood hit my face.On the sofa in the living room, Xia Xuan was only wearing a suspender nightgown. One hand was hanging in the air, with a long wound on her wrist. Blood dripped down her fingertips onto the woolen carpet, dyeing the white carpet red.

"Police officer, did Xia Xuan commit suicide out of fear of crime?" As soon as the medical staff came out, reporters gathered around her.

"Did Xia Xuan commit suicide or commit suicide? Is she really the murderer of the 211 dismemberment case? Officer, please say a few words."

"Sorry, it's inconvenient to disclose, please give way." The police separated the reporters and escorted Xia Xuan into the ambulance.

#Xiaxuan commits suicide in fear of crime#

#211 Dismemberment Case Murderer#

The hot searches were all covered by the 211 dismemberment case.
